title: Backstage Talent Scraper
description: Walks the Backstage Talent Database and saves each profile's link, name, and any contact links found. Remembers where it left off between runs.

startUrl.title: Backstage Talent Search URL
startUrl.description: Paste the exact Backstage talent search URL with your filters applied.

authState.title: Backstage cookies
authState.description: Paste the full cookie export from Cookie Editor, or a Playwright storage state.

useResidentialProxy.title: Use residential proxy
useResidentialProxy.description: Routes traffic through home style addresses so Cloudflare is less likely to block it. Costs about 8 dollars per GB.

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages This Run
maxPages.description: Stop this run after this many pages. Use 0 for unlimited.

maxProfiles.title: Maximum Profiles This Run
maxProfiles.description: Stop this run after this many profiles. Use 0 for unlimited.
